title: Ambush at the felled oak
text: Escorting Bram the tinker toward Imre, Sebak spots a felled oak across the road. A crossbowman waits in an ash tree and two brigands crouch in the hawthorn ditch. Sebak acts first in the surprise round.

title: The crow in the wind
text: At the felled oak Sebak dropped the crossbowman from behind, killed one brigand and fell to the other's club. As the final blow came down, something in his blood answered: every scrap of iron and wood nearby rang like a struck bell, the brigand's club burst apart in his hands, and he fled screaming into the hawthorn. Sebak woke at 1 HP, empty of chakra and shaking, with Bram bleeding beside him and the crossbowman still senseless in the ash tree.
